integrity: Symbolic identities and direct-rational tests reproduced by standalone verify_spam.py; infinite conclusions require the analytic Perron--Frobenius and Lyapunov arguments. No independent scientific validation.
scientific_limitations: Exact two-client scalar convex quadratic benchmark with half refresh, independent equal-probability sampling, and exact proximal steps. Unbounded gradient variance prevents applying the cited general bounded-variance convergence theorem to this example. No claim of almost-sure convergence, higher-dimensional generalization, or independently established novelty.
title: A sharp mean-square stability barrier for stochastic proximal steps with momentum variance reduction
